positions.name: Sprint4DeliveryEvidence
positions.frame: what evidence, taken together, establishes that Sprint 4 delivered on the async decision-capture product and validated the thesis behind it?
positions.why: All three assertions are delivered in the same flat, matter-of-fact, informational register with positive affect and communal framing ('we shipped', 'key unlock') rather than as isolated status updates — read together they form a single evidentiary chain: the artifact shipped (src-1), the velocity that resulted (src-2), and the integration credited as the mechanism that made both possible (src-3). No one segment alone argues the sprint's success; the frame holds because the three facts are offered as mutually reinforcing proof of delivery, mirroring the pattern the corpus already recognizes elsewhere (e.g. Position_Sprint4ThesisProven) where shipped-artifact, metric, and enabling-integration are read as one argument rather than three separate claims.
